about: The PCB corpus pcb_fetch.py fetches and pcb_bench.py's tasks run on, smallest tier first. An `upstream` project is downloaded from GitHub at `commit` (a full sha; `ref` is the tag it was resolved from, if any): `files` are relative to `root`, the project's folder in that repository, each with its sha256 and size (none over 10 MB; 3D models, gerbers and images are not fetched), and `board` and `schematic` are among them. `licence` is its SPDX id, from `licence_file` (a path in the repository, kept beside the project); non-commercial and no-licence designs are refused. `kicad_format`, `copper_layers`, `footprints` and `bytes` were measured from the fetched files (cad.kicad_pcb.inspect). A `build` project is this repository's own sample (`sample`), its tracked files copied and its `build` script run in the copy.
